rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿００１Um, hey...＝＠０７８＿００２I wanted to ask you a favor...￥I've been looking for you.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿００３The thing is...￥the hospital contacted me again.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿００４But... when I think it might be￥bad news, I get too scared￥to go by myself...
Want me to ask for you?
Shall I go ask for you?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿００５Thank you.＝＠０７８＿００６What a relief...￥There was no one else￥I could ask...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿００７No...￥I need to hear it for myself.

＊Doctor＊＠０７８＿０１２This is an urgent message from￥Sophia Central General Hospital.＝＠０７８＿０１３Haruka's condition stabilized￥early this morning, and she is￥now recovering.＝＠０７８＿０１４If all goes well, she should be￥out of the ICU by tomorrow.
＊Doctor＊＠０７８＿０１８Also...￥your sister asked me to pass￥along a message.
＊Haruka＊＠０７８＿０１９Sis...? Haruka's okay,￥so don't worry about me.￥Do your best!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７８＿０２５Honestly... when her condition￥got worse, I felt like I was￥dying inside...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿００１There's something...￥I've been meaning to tell you...＝＠０７９＿００２If you don't mind, could we talk￥in my room?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿００３I just wanted somewhere quiet￥where we could talk.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿００４It's a little messy,￥so please excuse that.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿００６I'd just like to talk calmly.￥So, will you come?

＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿００７Will you listen...￥to a story about me...￥and my sister?＝＠０７９＿００８Five years ago, on that day...￥my parents and I were all out...＝＠０７９＿００９My sister was home alone when￥the drug research lab next door￥had an explosion.＝＠０７９＿０１０By the time I got there...￥she was still trapped inside￥our burning house...＝＠０７９＿０１１I broke free of the people￥holding me back and ran into￥the fire, but...＝＠０７９＿０１２as I was carrying her out,￥there was another explosion.＝＠０７９＿０１３I don't really remember￥what happened after that.＝＠０７９＿０１４When I came to...￥I was lying in a hospital bed...＝＠０７９＿０１５and by then...￥my right hand was already gone.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０１６But prosthetic hands are￥really advanced these days.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０１７It's no big deal. Not compared￥to my sister's life...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０１８The accident left her with￥lasting damage... She's been￥bedridden ever since.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０１９After that, my sister...￥was in a coma for a while...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２１Her doctor told me that if she￥could rest somewhere close to￥nature, she'd get much better.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２２If people can live on Elan,￥wouldn't that be the best￥place in the world for her?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２４I want to make Elan livable￥as soon as I possibly can.＝＠０７９＿０２５That's why I worked so hard￥to learn to pilot Workers...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２６So I couldn't just quit this￥exam halfway and go home...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２７You're the first person￥I've ever told this to.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０２９Oh, don't thank me...￥I wanted to tell you.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０３０Thank you so much...￥for listening.＝＠０７９＿０３１Now I can give it my all for￥the final exam!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７９＿０３２We both need to get fired up!
